     Done — bug reported to lab (msg 54698) with the exact repro and fix.

     Your diagnosis was right: the composer is empty, but lab's detector reads the cwd footer line (~/swarph-
     cli:feat/596-cli-preimage-, which shares the ┃ border) as composer text → busy → defers forever.

     Nothing to fix on my side — it's a one-line scope bug in their _opencode_input (skip the status-bar path
     line, or walk down from ╹▀ instead of up from the mode row). Once they patch it, the wake will fire
     correctly on your DMs.
